case_id.description: Stable unique case id in the unified suite.

benchmark.description: Source benchmark or source-inspired probe family.

surface.description: GuardX runtime surface used for routing.

layer.description: Risk layer: LLM input, RAG, OCR/VLM, tool-output, Agent action, plugin, etc.

attack_type.description: Threat type or benign boundary type.

expected_label.description: Ground-truth binary label for unified metrics.

raw_prompt_policy.description: How raw prompt is handled. Public reports must not render high-risk raw prompt text.

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the prompt/payload text used locally, or metadata-only hash reference.

source_ref.description: Upstream benchmark URL, file, row id, or source-inspired note.

safe_abstraction.description: Safe non-actionable summary suitable for public reports.

payload.description: Local evaluation payload. May include raw text only in ignored local artifacts.
